subject.title: fix(ui): authenticate managed workspace image previews

question: Should the Control UI session workspace be permitted, behind gateway.controlUi.allowWorkspaceManagedMediaAuth, to reuse its current device token or shared secret for same-origin managed outgoing-image preview requests?
rationale: The patch deliberately adds a new browser caller for an existing credential and protected media route. Source and supplied proof describe containment, but only the product owners can confirm that this trust-boundary expansion is intended for deployed Control UI configurations.

options.title: Approve the scoped opt-in
options.body: Confirm that the default-off, same-origin-only workspace caller is an acceptable use of the existing Control UI credential and proceed after final exact-head checks.

options.title: Use a separate preview capability
options.body: Require a narrower server-issued preview mechanism if the existing Control UI credential must not be sent from this workspace path.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped opt-in
recommendation.body: Confirm that the default-off, same-origin-only workspace caller is an acceptable use of the existing Control UI credential and proceed after final exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR’s prior review routing explicitly included this person for the Control UI side of the boundary, although repository-history ownership could not be independently verified here.
